content.json:
# Homelab Security Operations

Detection-engineering metrics across **Microsoft Sentinel + Defender XDR**. Everything below is deployed **as code** (Sigma -> CI/CD -> Sentinel/Defender): 5 scheduled analytics rules, 5 Defender custom detections, a SOAR notification playbook, and 3 threat-intelligence feeds. Use the time range to scope the incident/alert tiles.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
 (SecurityIncident | summarize Value = dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend Name = 'Incidents'),
 (SecurityIncident | where Status != 'Closed' | summarize Value = dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend Name = 'Open incidents'),
 (SecurityAlert | summarize Value = count() | extend Name = 'Alerts'),
 (ThreatIntelIndicators | summarize Value = count() | extend Name = 'TI indicators')
| project Name, Value

SecurityAlert
| extend Tactic = split(tostring(Tactics), ',')
| mv-expand Tactic to typeof(string)
| extend Tactic = trim(' ', Tactic)
| where isnotempty(Tactic)
| summarize Alerts = count() by Tactic
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: Alerts by ATT&CK tactic

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| summarize Alerts = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Detection = AlertName, Severity = AlertSeverity
| order by Alerts desc
content.title: Alerts by detection

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Severity) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Incidents = count() by Severity, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Incidents over time by severity

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Incidents = count() by Severity, Status
content.title: Incidents by severity & status

content.json:
## Threat intelligence feed health

Three feeds ingested as code: **MDTI** (connector), **AlienVault OTX** (TAXII), **abuse.ch ThreatFox** (STIX upload pipeline).

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| summarize Indicators = count() by Feed = SourceSystem
| order by Indicators desc
content.title: Indicators by feed

content.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where isnotempty(ObservableKey)
| summarize Indicators = count() by Type = tostring(ObservableKey)
| order by Indicators desc
| take 10
content.title: Indicator types (top 10)
